cues: They land, drink from the river, and walk into the jungle.
Wells builds the setting as a contrast.
The beach is blazing glare, dry lips, thirst and hurry.
The forest is cool shadow under trees like vast pillars, so silent that Evans shivers: it seems almost cold here.
From bright and open to dark and enclosed: from hope to danger.
